payload.rebuttal: fixed: Added tests/test_reconcile.py::test_the_merged_head_is_written_before_the_state_moves. It monkeypatches ledger.record_merged_head and ledger.set_task_state with spies that log to a list, runs reconcile over a single MERGED task, and asserts the log equals ["head", "state"]. I confirmed this test fails against the exact swap the critic proposed (set_task_state called first, then record_merged_head), and passes against the committed code where record_merged_head is called first. That closes the gap: the durability ordering the spec required is now pinned by an assertion on call order, not just by the two calls both happening to run.
